sections.Profile:
"Operation: Thunder" is a pinball machine by D. Gottlieb & Co., released in March 1992. It features an aviation theme with three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode. Designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell, the machine is part of the Gottlieb System 3 series. A total of 2,513 units were produced.
